import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Amount distribution by fraud status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
data.boxplot(column='amount', by='is_fraud', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Fraud Status')
ax1.set_xlabel('Is Fraud (0=No, 1=Yes)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.sca(ax1)
plt.xticks([1, 2], ['No', 'Yes'])

# 2. Transaction type distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(transaction_counts))
ax2.bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Transactions by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hour_counts = data['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax3.plot(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax3.fill_between(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Activity by Hour of Day')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_xlim(0, 23)

# 4. Average amount by transaction type with fraud overlay
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
pivot_data = data.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud'])['amount'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'])
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status')
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)')
ax4.legend(['No Fraud', 'Fraud'], title='Fraud Status')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
